result.stdout:
Usage: when [options] [<input> [+/-offset] | diff <time1> <time2>]

Convert timestamps between formats, apply time arithmetic, and calculate durations.

Options:
  --utc       Output only UTC ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)
  --local     Output only local ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)
  --iso       Output only ISO 8601 duration string (diff mode)
  --tz ZONE   Display in this timezone (IANA or Windows ID)
  -h, --help  Show help
  --version   Show version
  --color     Force colored output
  --no-color  Disable colored output
  --json      JSON output
  --describe  Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  125  Usage error — bad arguments, unparseable input, unknown timezone
